SC-001.state: After school, daylight from the west windows behind the president's seat (she is a little backlit). れいか wears the 生徒会長 armband on her LEFT arm and holds a binder or the club application sheet. ねむ carries nothing; her blazer sleeves cover her hands.

SC-002.state: Old-building 3rd-floor corridor. すず holds her club entry form (入部届) — NO stamp on it yet — and a big school bag on her shoulder. The clubroom sliding door is opened only a little; a paper notice 「生徒会室。すぐ戻る（たぶん）」 is taped on the door. たけし is inside, sitting at the east side of the kotatsu in front of the steel shelf.

SC-003.state: Same corridor. 棚橋先生 in a white shirt, loose tie, sandals, an attendance book under his arm. After he stamps it (from PN-014 on), すず's 入部届 has a round red-ink stamp (draw it as a small circle). Door still slightly open; たけし still inside at the kotatsu.

SC-004.time: 放課後（晴れ、少し傾いた光）
SC-004.state: Inside the clubroom: kotatsu in the middle with its quilt, a tray and a teapot on top (no cups yet). ねむ sits at the NORTH side, すず kneels (seiza) at the SOUTH side with her 入部届 and bag beside her, たけし sits hugging his knees at the EAST side in front of the steel shelf. Two notices on the north wall: the club application and the 廃部 notice.

SC-005.state: Evening sun through the south windows (long light patches, can be shown later with tone). Same seats as SC-004. From PN-032 on there are THREE teacups (湯のみ) on the kotatsu, one each for ねむ, すず and たけし; steam rises from them.
